top.title: ONG Médicos Sem Fronteiras denuncia morte de dois funcionários em ataque israelense em Gaza
top.summary: A organização humanitária Médicos Sem Fronteiras (MSF) manifestou indignação neste sábado (28) após a morte de dois de seus funcionários em um ataque israelense contra uma clínica na Cidade de Gaza. O bombardeio ocorreu na noite de sexta-feira (27), apesar do cessar-fogo em vigor no território palestino.

articles.title: Gaza strike kills two Doctors Without Borders staff Israel links to Hamas
articles.summary: Doctors Without Borders (MSF) voiced outrage on Saturday after an Israeli strike killed two staff members at a clinic in Gaza, while the Israeli military said the pair were Hamas "terrorists". The Friday night strike in Gaza City drew swift condemnation from the head of the UN's World Health Organization and came despite a ceasefire in the war-shattered Palestinian territory.

articles.title: Israeli Strike Kills 2 Workers at Gaza Clinic, Doctors Without Borders Says
articles.summary: The aid group condemned the attack on a medical facility. Israel said it had conducted a targeted strike that killed two security guards it said were Hamas operatives.

articles.title: Israeli strike on Gaza kills two medics from Doctors Without Borders
articles.summary: An Israeli strike killed two doctors who were working members of Doctors Without Borders in Gaza City on Friday night, drawing widespread condemnation, including from the UN's World Health Organization. Israeli military claims the pair were Hamas "terrorists".

articles.title: Israeli strike kills two Doctors Without Borders staff in Gaza
articles.summary: Doctors Without Borders (MSF) said Saturday an Israeli strike killed two staff members at a clinic in Gaza, with the Israeli army labelling the pair as Hamas "terrorists". Noga Tarnopolsky is live from Jerusalem.

articles.title: Israeli army acknowledges Gaza strike that killed two MSF workers
articles.summary: The Israeli military has confirmed it carried out a strike in Gaza City that killed two employees at a clinic run by Doctors Without Borders (MSF). The army on Saturday identified the men as Ahmed Sufyan Muhammad Ali Abu Hasira and Moaz Yousef Alitsbach. It said the two were working as security guards at the clinic while advancing plans to attack Israeli civilians and troops. articles.title: Two staff killed in Israeli strike on Gaza medical clinic, MSF says
articles.summary: The Israeli military says it targeted "Hamas terrorists" in the strike which has been condemned by the World Health Organization.

articles.title: IDF says Gaza strike killed two terror operatives working for Doctors Without Borders
Doctors Without Borders says two staff killed in Israeli 'direct hit' on Gaza clinic
articles.summary: Two employees of Doctors Without Borders (MSF) were killed in an Israeli strike on one of the organisation's clinics in the Gaza Strip on Friday. The strike was a "direct hit" on the clinic, the organisation said. "We are devastated and outraged by the killing of two of our colleagues, both watchmen, in an Israeli strike on one of our Gaza clinics tonight," MSF said in a post on X.
